## Task 19: Spatial Data and Measure Data

### Background

Up to this point, we have dealt with data that fits into the tidy format without much effort. Spatial data has many complicating factors that have made handling spatial data complicated. Big strides are being made to make clean spatial data tidy in Python. However; we are in the middle of the transition.

We will use Plotly to make a map of the US and show the top 3 largest cities in each state. Specifically, you will use `plotly.choropleth()` to recreate the provided image.
